card.name: Small words in general-interest prose
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on scattered small words such as of, so, at, on, in, up or the in non-medical essay and science-news prose.

modes.label: Prepositions and particles
modes.description: A small linking word like of, at, on, in or up mid-sentence in popular science or history writing.
